description: Read the company's frontend repo at its latest commit and index every component: its stories, props, where it is used and what it needs to render. It starts a job and never changes the repo; component_catalog shows the result when `scanned_at` moves. You confirm in a dialog first.

company.description: the company id (list_companies); not needed when you have one company, asked for otherwise

repo.description: the repo id, or its full name (owner/repo); the company's main frontend repo when left out

name: scan_components
title: Scan the components
